units.source_text: 她就那么站着躲在走廊上，并没有要进屋的意思。

en.t: She simply stood there hiding in the corridor, showing no intention of coming into the room.

units.source_text: 岛村手拿毛巾走了出来。

en.t: Shimamura came out with a towel in his hand.

units.source_text: 驹子避开他的目光，低下头走在前面，

en.t: Komako avoided his gaze and walked ahead with her head lowered,

units.source_text: 简直像给人揭发了罪行后被逮走的样子。

en.t: looking exactly like someone being led away after her crime had been exposed.

units.source_text: 可是，在浴池里把身子暖和过来以后，她又怪可怜地闹腾起来，这时她毫无睡意了。

en.t: But after warming herself in the bath, she began making a strangely pitiable fuss again, and by then she was not sleepy at all.
